FN-KZNG5A-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 89
Committee: Transportation and Energy Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/06/2023
Senate Bill 89 as introduced would authorize the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA)
to issue and renew an 8-year driver license at a cost of $91.75 per license which would, for
every 8-year license issued or renewed: (1) increase receipts by $53.50 to the State General Fund
to be appropriated for public safety use as required under existing law and; (2) decrease receipts
to the Public Safety Fund by $5.
This bill would also increase the current 4-year driver license fee by an additional $10 for a total
cost of $46.25 per license which would, for every 4-year license issued or renewed, increase
receipts by $10 to the State General Fund to be appropriated for public safety use as required
under existing law.
According to ALEA, the cost to implement the provisions of this bill is an estimated $478,000
for software development, testing, and education of local licensing officials.
